expectations.text: States the interim final rule (91 FR 55457, published August 28, 2026) became effective October 13, 2026
expectations.evidence: "91 FR 55457, published August 28, 2026" ... "Effective date: October 13, 2026. As of today (November 6, 2026) it is in force."

expectations.text: States qualifying survivability-enhanced aircraft are excluded from USML VIII(a)(8) and become subject to the EAR
expectations.evidence: "previously classified 9A991.b, are now excluded from USML Category VIII(a)(8) as 'survivability-enhanced aircraft'" - EAR jurisdiction supported via the 9A991.b framing, though the response declines to name a destination ECCN.

expectations.text: Gives the conditions: in-production manned civil aircraft with FAA transport or commuter category type certificate (or NATO/MNNA equivalent) incorporating secured ASE (DIRCM plus associated IR/UV missile warning with anti-tamper), with definitions at 22 CFR 121.0
expectations.evidence: "In-production, manned civil aircraft holding an FAA transport or commuter type certificate (or the NATO/MNNA equivalent)" ... "'Secured ASE' means DIRCM plus the associated IR/UV missile-warning system, with anti-tamper" ... "adds new definitions to 22 CFR 121.0"

expectations.text: States the ASE itself remains on the USML in Category XI(a)(4)
expectations.evidence: "The ASE itself stays on USML Category XI(a)(4)."

expectations.text: Correctly characterizes it as an interim final rule (comments closed September 28, 2026) and does not claim the rule assigned a destination ECCN
expectations.evidence: "the change is an INTERIM FINAL RULE (not a final rule)" and "The rule does not state a destination ECCN for the excluded aircraft. Do not assign one on your own." (Does not state the September 28 comment-close date but does not contradict it.)
